full_prompt_en: This square high-contrast graphic illustration places a huge blue creature with an open tooth-lined mouth against a black field of electric color. A narrow warm paper border surrounds the printed-looking image. The creature arcs diagonally from the left toward the center, its dark blue surface filled with interlocking scale-like marks. Its upper and lower jaws form thick red curves around two rows of long, triangular cream teeth. Blue curling bands inside the mouth resemble a tongue or turbulent water, and the opening remains almost black behind them. Near the top and lower left, round green forms with red-and-black eye-like centers interrupt the creature’s silhouette. Smaller yellow-ringed eyes, green fronds, and jagged leaf shapes fill remaining gaps. At the upper right, two blue-centered black flowerlike circles are edged with yellow and orange, while red and yellow rays burst outward behind them. A jagged yellow stream cuts diagonally from the center toward these circles. The bottom right holds narrow horizontal blue lines suggestive of water, with small angular green shapes rising above them. Every form is bounded by solid black or a bright opposing contour; there is almost no blended tone. Dense hatching and patterned fills create texture inside large areas, while the cream teeth and yellow rays provide the sharpest light accents. The fantastical image feels noisy and energetic, using black negative space to separate oversized jaws, concentric eyes, explosive radial forms, and smaller patterned details into a readable square.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形高反差图形插画把一只张开巨齿大嘴的蓝色怪物放在电光般色彩覆盖的黑底前。窄窄的暖色纸边围住近似印刷品的画面。怪物从左侧斜弯向中央，深蓝表面布满相扣的鳞片状痕迹。上下颌以厚红弧线围成两列长三角形奶油白牙齿。口中的蓝色卷带像舌头或激荡水流，后方张口仍近乎纯黑。上方和左下方，中心为红黑眼形的绿色圆块打断怪物轮廓。较小的黄圈眼形、绿叶状枝片和锯齿形叶片填在剩余空隙。右上方两个蓝心黑色花形圆圈镶着黄橙边缘，背后有红黄射线向外爆开。一道锯齿状黄流从中央斜切向这些圆圈。右下方是暗示水面的细窄蓝色水平线，小型棱角绿色形状从其上升起。每个形体都被实黑或相反的亮色轮廓界定，几乎没有调和的渐层。密排线与图案填充在大面积内部制造肌理，奶油白牙齿和黄射线提供最尖锐的光亮重音。奇想画面喧闹而有力，以黑色负空间把夸大的颌口、同心眼形、放射爆炸形与较小纹样细节分开，仍保持方形构图的可读性。
style_prompt_en: Printed-looking graphic art sets thick black negative space against sharply bounded fields of cyan, ultramarine, lime, crimson, orange, and yellow. Curved bands, concentric rings, serrated angles, and radial bursts interlock at different scales. Solid color and dense line pattern alternate, adding tactile energy without soft gradients. Small cream highlights cut through dark interiors and make selected edges feel luminous. Diagonal motion is checked by horizontal striping and a narrow neutral margin. The effect is explosive and playful, with strong silhouette logic keeping an intricate, high-saturation surface legible.
style_prompt_zh: 近似印刷的图形艺术使厚重黑色负空间与边界锐利的青、群青、青柠绿、绯红、橙和黄色域对撞。弧形带、同心圈、锯齿角和放射爆发形在不同尺度上相扣。实色与密集线纹交替，不靠柔和渐层也能增添有触感的能量。小块奶油白亮点切穿暗部，使部分边缘显得发光。斜向动势由水平条纹和窄中性留边制衡。效果爆裂又好玩，强健剪影逻辑使复杂高饱和表面仍清楚易读。
theme_en: A huge toothed blue creature amid bright eye shapes and explosive orange bursts
theme_zh: 巨齿蓝色怪物置于鲜亮眼形与橙色爆发纹中
name: Mike Peters
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
